description: Underwrite a real-estate investment deal and get a 0-100 score, verdict, cash flow, cap rate, DSCR, stress tests, break-even thresholds, and a shareable report link. Strategies: ltr (long-term rental), str (short-term rental), brrr, multifamily, flip (fix-n-flip), newc (new construction). All rates/percents are FRACTIONS (0.0675 = 6.75%). Omitted operating inputs are filled with documented defaults and listed in assumptions.estimated_fields. Output is a software estimate, not financial, investment, tax or legal advice — figures are projections to verify, not recommendations. Free, no key; the response includes a shareable report_url.

inputs.description: Deal inputs in camelCase engine keys. Anything omitted gets a documented default, listed back under assumptions.estimated_fields. Minimum: price + the strategy's income driver (marketRent / adr+occupancy / units / arv / land+build). Call list_strategies for the full per-strategy schema.

adr.description: Average nightly rate in dollars. Required for str.

arv.description: After-repair value in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

btsArv.description: Finished build-to-sell value in dollars. Required for newc.

buildPsf.description: Build cost per square foot in dollars. Required for newc.

downPct.description: Down payment. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional — a documented default applies.

landPrice.description: Land acquisition cost in dollars. Required for newc.

livingSqft.description: Heated living area in square feet. Required for newc.

marketRent.description: Expected monthly rent in dollars. Required for ltr and brrr.

occupancy.description: Expected occupancy. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Required for str.

price.description: Purchase price in dollars. Required for every strategy except newc.

rate.description: Annual interest rate. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

rehabBudget.description: Renovation budget in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

taxes.description: Annual property taxes in dollars. Optional.

units.description: Multifamily rent roll — {unitCount, avgRent, marketRent?} or an array of unit objects. Required for multifamily.

vacancyPct.description: Vacancy allowance. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

name: analyze_deal

assumptions.description: estimated_fields lists every input REIzer defaulted.

breakdown.description: Ordered cash-flow / profit waterfall rows {label, amount, kind}; outflows are negative.

data_note.description: REIzer data tools that can refine this analysis (needs an API key).

disclaimer.description: Not financial advice — software estimate only.

inputs_used.description: The resolved input set the analysis ran on — caller values plus documented defaults.

levers.description: Top input changes that would each add ~$1,000/yr cash flow (STR).

sensitivity.description: Which input drivers move the result most — {driver, range, low_impact, high_impact, swing}, sorted by swing (STR).

stress.description: Stress scenarios, each with a verdict.

upfront.description: Cash-into-the-deal / project-cost stack rows {label, amount, kind}.

verdict.description: Strong (85+) / Solid (70+) / Workable (50+) / Risky (25+) / Run Away.

title: Analyze a real-estate deal
